title: Hp500CrusherBayes
description: Catalog row hp500-crusherbayes 1.0.1: CrusherBayes, the Bayesian calibration of the crusher engine's fitted scalars with a structural discrepancy per target, held out on the ten HP500 surveys, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/hp500/crusherbayes.py to data/derived/hp500/crusherbayes.json by the offline bake (CI never runs the sampler, ADR-0074: it validates the committed document). One posterior per fold from nine surveys (strict leave-one-survey-out as hp500-loo) and one from all ten for the contraction table; per held-out survey the posterior predictive mean and 80 percent interval for the two measured targets (throughput tph [t/h] and power kW [kW]; P80 is not measured and is never a target); scores beside B_lin, M0 (the CrusherCal band) and M2; the convergence diagnostic of every posterior; the kill criterion of the SDD evaluated into a verdict. Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: n equals the length of every per-survey list; the verdict equals kill_criterion recomputed from the numbers it carries; convergence.all_converged is true exactly when every fold entry is converged; a posterior that fails its diagnostic is recorded with converged false and is never dropped from the document; the document is byte-identical for the same inputs and seed. Derived from data licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://doi.org/10.3390/min14090919).

engine_version.description: The product version that wrote the document (format X.XX.XXX); a version other than VERSION makes the row stale.

n.description: The number of surveys, and of held-out folds.

seed.description: The seed from which the seed of every posterior (ten folds and the fit to all ten surveys) is spawned.

inputs_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the survey table, the sampler size, the seed and the priors the document was sampled from.

sampler_version.description: The emcee release the document was sampled with.

move.description: The ensemble moves: DEMove 0.8 and DESnookerMove 0.2, with their sources.

walkers.description: The number of walkers of each chain.

steps.description: The number of steps of each chain.

burn_in_steps.description: The steps discarded at the start of each chain.

thin.description: The thinning of the retained chain (every thin-th step).

predictive_draws_per_sample.description: The predictive draws per retained posterior sample; the 80 percent interval is their quantile.

likelihood.description: The likelihood in words: Gaussian on the measured throughput and power, the discrepancy integrated out exactly.

discrepancy_prior_sd.description: The prior standard deviation tau of each discrepancy coefficient, per target, per standardised unit of the setting and f80.

median.description: The median of sigma per target, 5 percent of a typical survey level.

log_sd.description: The standard deviation of ln sigma.

noise_prior.description: The prior of the observation noise sigma of each target: ln sigma normal around ln of a median.

p80.description: Why P80 is not a target: it is not measured.

interval_80.description: How the 80 percent interval is read: the 10th and 90th percentiles of the predictive draws of the held-out survey.

method.description: The sampler, its size, the likelihood and the priors of the discrepancy and of the noise.

unit.description: The scalar's unit, or - when it has none.

nominal.description: The engine's shipped value, in the natural scale and the unit of the row.

log.description: True when the scalar is sampled as its natural log.

sd.description: The prior standard deviation in the sampled space.

lo.description: The lower truncation bound in the sampled space.

hi.description: The upper truncation bound in the sampled space.

source.description: The source of the nominal value and the reason for the width.

items.description: One truncated normal per engine scalar, in the sampled space (ln of the value when log is true), with its source.

priors.description: The truncated normal prior of every engine scalar, in the sampled space, with its source.

tau_factor.description: A chain converges when its post-burn length is at least this many integrated autocorrelation times.

fold.description: The held-out survey number, or all for the fit to all ten.

converged.description: Whether the posterior meets the rule.

tau_max.description: The largest integrated autocorrelation time over the parameters [steps].

post_burn_steps.description: The chain length after the burn-in [steps].

acceptance_fraction.description: The mean acceptance fraction of the walkers [fraction].

samples.description: The number of retained posterior samples (walkers times post-burn steps over thin).

folds.description: One row per posterior: the ten folds, then the fit to all ten surveys.

convergence.description: The convergence diagnostics of every posterior.

loo.description: The held-out predictive of CrusherBayes per measured target.

comparators.description: Three CrusherCal models scored the way CrusherBayes is, per target.

comparators_note.description: How the comparators are scored, in words.

name.description: The scalar's name (an engine scalar, sigma of a target, or a discrepancy coefficient).

unit.description: The scalar's unit, or - when it has none.

nominal.description: The prior centre in the natural scale (0 for a discrepancy coefficient).

prior_sd.description: The prior standard deviation in the natural scale, in the unit of the row.

posterior_mean.description: The posterior mean, in the unit of the row.

posterior_sd.description: The posterior standard deviation, in the unit of the row.

contraction.description: Posterior over prior standard deviation: below 0.5 the surveys identify the scalar, near 1 it stays at its prior.
Posterior against prior on the fit to all ten surveys, one row per sampled scalar and discrepancy coefficient.

contraction_note.description: How the contraction is read, in words.

margin_mape_pts.description: The MAPE margin of the rule, 3 points [points].

coverage_band.description: The coverage band of the 80 percent interval, 0.7 to 0.9 [fraction].

tph_mape_m0_pct.description: The calibrated backbone's held-out MAPE on throughput [%].

tph_gain_over_m0_pts.description: The backbone's MAPE minus CrusherBayes's on throughput [points].

a_tph_beats_m0_by_margin.description: Whether that gain is at least the margin.

a_holds.description: Condition (a): neither gain reaches the margin.

coverage.description: The empirical coverage of the 80 percent interval per target.

coverage_outside_band.description: Per target, whether the coverage lies outside the band.

mean_width.description: The mean width of CrusherBayes's 80 percent interval per target.

band_wider_than_crushercal.description: Per target, whether CrusherBayes's mean width exceeds the CrusherCal band's.

b_holds.description: Condition (b): on either target the coverage lies outside the band or the band is wider.

verdict.description: The outcome: dropped as a predictor when (a) and (b) hold, kept otherwise.

paper.description: Authors, year and title of the source publication.

doi.description: The DOI of the source publication.
